Frequently Asked Questions

Is MUET better than UET Taxila?

Both Mehran University of Engineering and Technology and University of Engineering & Technology Taxila are HEC-recognized universities. MUET is public (est. 1976) in Jamshoro / Khairpur, while UET Taxila is public (est. 1975) in Taxila. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between MUET and UET Taxila?

MUET's fee is approximately Rs. 42K–1.3L/sem per semester, while UET Taxila's is Rs. 30–50K/sem. See the full comparison above.
